criteria.name: Mission concept and rationale — What will it do, who are the users, why is it needed?
criteria.reasoning: Clear mission function, Australian benefit, users identified, need justified with bleaching statistics and monitoring gap. Literature referenced. Lacks formal requirements but otherwise complete.

evidence.quote: would allow marine and conservation scientists to more accurately predict and react to coral bleaching events

criteria.name: Project plan — How you plan to complete the assignment, including either a Gantt chart or a timetable and information sources you plan to use
criteria.reasoning: Detailed Gantt to week 10 with tasks for launch, orbit, ground, comms, EOL, STK and editing buffer. Linked to mission narrative. Sources listed. Contingency only Week 10 buffer.

evidence.quote: Project work will be divided into weeks via a Gantt Chart

criteria.name: Preliminary progress — Technical content and evidence of sufficient work done to date
criteria.reasoning: Only background reading on Asner system and bleaching plus STK tutorials claimed. No calculations, orbit values, simulations or results presented. Insufficient to show on-track design.

criteria.name: Report presentation
criteria.reasoning: Logical structure, clear writing, consistent formatting, readable Gantt chart. In-text footnotes match references. Extra Useful Links uncited but does not impede reading.

evidence.quote: Australia’s Great Barrier Reef is the largest coral reef in the world

overall: Strong concept and plan with good sources and presentation. Main weakness is lack of preliminary quantitative design results, limiting technical progress evidence.

feedback.summary: You presented a strong coral-bleaching monitoring concept for Australia with a clear plan and professional presentation. Your mission rationale and Gantt to week 10 are well developed. Your main gap is preliminary technical progress, where you need quantitative design results to show you are on track for the full mission.
next_steps: Add formal measurable mission requirements to your Mission Concept & Rationale to complete your goals and objectives.
Expand contingency in your Project Plan & Preliminary Progress beyond the Week 10 buffer with explicit plans for variations.
Produce early quantitative results such as candidate orbit parameters or STK outputs with interpretation to move to Accomplished in progress.

criteria.C1: In Mission Concept & Rationale you clearly linked monitoring to marine and conservation scientists predicting bleaching, with Australian benefit and literature. To strengthen within Accomplished, add formal mission goals, objectives and measurable requirements.
criteria.C2: Your Project Plan & Preliminary Progress Gantt to week 10 covering launch, orbit, ground, comms, EOL, STK and editing fits your narrative with appropriate sources. To strengthen, add explicit contingency for variations beyond the Week 10 buffer.
criteria.C3: You reported background reading on the Asner system and STK tutorials 1-4 in Project Plan & Preliminary Progress. For Accomplished you need a preliminary set of quantitative results with description and interpretation.
criteria.C4: Your structure is logical and easy to read with consistent formatting and readable Gantt in Image 1, and footnotes matching references. To hold Accomplished, keep formatting consistent and cite all Useful Links sources.
